entities.name: Query protein 192 aa
observations: Sequence is 192 aa with estimated molecular mass 21.46 kDa and theoretical pI 5.86.
Best reviewed homolog is Flavobacterium johnsoniae dITP/XTP pyrophosphatase A5FH89: 64.7% identity and 99% query coverage; annotation suggests Mg2+-dependent hydrolysis of XTP, dITP, and ITP.
Functional evidence is homology-based; exact substrate specificity is not experimentally established for this query sequence.
